posts.post_subject: arrgh - can't find document describing mode hopping
posts.content_md:
A while ago there was a discussion on mode hopping, and I think there was a pointer to a paper describling the relationship of power and temperature to laser diode frequency. The reason I'm asking is that I'm having problems getting my (formerly) stable diode setup behaving in a stable fashion - I think it might be related to temperature in my room. I made a few bad plates before I put the diode on the interferometer and determined there was a problem with stability. The low power diodes seem to be far more stable than the high power setups :p Can anyone here remember the name/link of the paper? I did some searching in the archive, but I've come up empty handed.

Thanks for your assistance.

--Ted.
